response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM award_counts), compared AS (SELECT award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_hands FROM shares) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_award_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_hands) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_hands
